event.title: Join the FSFE at Berlin Fediverse Day 2026, Germany in Berlin, Germany

body.p: The Berlin Fediverse Day 2026 is organized by the Berlin Fediverse meetup at the c-base and take place during the weekend, from Friday 11 to Sunday 13 September.

On Sunday 13th, Ana Galan have a session about "Let's toot together! Using the Fediverse for outreach". It will discuss the various social media channels used by the FSFE and the reasons why, even though the Fediverse is our main tool, the FSFE is still present on some proprietary channels. The talk will be in English and it will take place at 12:00 in the c-base mainhall.
Tobias Diekershoff, who is also part of the organization, will do participate actively with a workshop.
If you are around, find us and say hi!
